full_judgment:
9. The defendant Bank has filed an application under Order VII, rule II of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint on the ground that the terms and conditions of service of the plaintiff are not regulated by any legal instrument and that the service of the plaintiff is guided by the law of Master and servant. The defendant also stated that the suit is hopelessly barred by limitation. 

 15. The appellant was dismissed on 5-7-1994 from the service of the respondent Bank and his appeal was also dismissed by the authority on 19-10-1994. Long after 13 years of the dismissal of the appeal this suit has been preferred by the appellant which is clearly barred by limitation.
